_comment: Sample APA export so recommendations work without an APA deployment. Real deployments point $ECHOCHAMBER_APA_DATA at their APA data directory (apa-roles.json + apa-state.json) or a merged export like this file. Shape: roles = per-use-case winner + ordered fallbacks; prices = scraped $/1M token table; cutoffs = minimum quality bar per role with rationale.

gcp-credits.name: GCP free-trial credits (Gemini via Vertex)
gcp-credits.note: Gemini/Vertex spend bills against these credits, not your card — burn them before they expire.

reasoning.why: Judging a debate is hard analysis: weighing argument quality, spotting logical gaps, and resisting rhetorical flourish takes frontier-tier reasoning.

daily.why: Advocacy needs solid comprehension and structured argumentation, not frontier depth; mid-tier models argue coherently without overpaying per turn.

cheap.why: Adequate for mechanical tasks; below this bar argument quality degrades noticeably.
